command:
set -u
ARCH=/var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/diag-archive
mkdir -p "$ARCH"
if [ -f /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics ]; then
  mv /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics "$ARCH/macws_runtime_diagnostics.r004b-20261014"
  echo "archived chroot sentinel"
fi
for p in /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics /tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics; do
  [ -e "$p" ] && echo "STILL EXISTS: $p" || echo "absent: $p"
done
ps aux | grep -iE "windowserver|evprobe|ws_event" | grep -v grep || echo "no ws/probe processes"
limit: A timeout kills the local SSH process group; remote work may need explicit cleanup.
